business_problem: Maxim needed to reinvent a legacy media business with a modern data architecture that could connect print, digital competitions, and advertising performance without requiring engineers to keep building custom panels and decks.
solution_summary: Maxim uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Maxim needed to reinvent a legacy media business with a modern data architecture that could connect print, digital competitions, and advertising performance without requiring engineers to keep building custom panels and decks. Looker serves as the live dashboard layer for business, operations, and engineering teams and now includes conversational capabilities for non-technical users, serving as the serving layer. BigQuery provides the read-replica style foundation for mixing historical experiments, transactional information, and real-time operational data, serving as the storage layer. Operational and campaign data is copied out of legacy systems into BigQuery, Looker surfaces live dashboards and natural-language analytics, and the same governed data foundation supports chargeback evidence, influencer tournament performance tracking, and downstream machine-learning models. The implementation integrates with Mixpanel, Segment, Webflow.
